presentation.title: Start from an evidence corpus you already have
presentation.body: Spis can adopt an unpacked canonical corpus in place. It validates the catalog index, every source and reference index, every referenced record, and the evidence provenance fields before saving the location. It never copies away or rewrites the original files.

presentation.title: One corpus path for every command
presentation.body: After adoption, CLI commands and Spis Desktop resolve the same persisted corpus root. Re-adopting the exact path reports every reference unchanged. ZIP, tar, gzip, 7z, rar, xz and zstd archives are refused explicitly; unpack one first so Spis can validate its files.

presentation.title: Adopt your existing corpus
presentation.body: Run `spis corpus adopt PATH` with a directory containing canonical `example-catalogs.json`, catalog `sources.json` and `references.json`, and the referenced evidence files. Success is recorded only after the location is persisted.
